title: Register to be an organ and tissue donor
summary: Learn how to register your decision to be an organ and tissue donor online.
intro:
If you are aged 16 or over and want to donate your organs and tissues for transplant after death, you can register your decision online with the Australian Organ Donor Register.

You will need your Medicare card to register online.

You can also check if you’re already registered as a donor.

Your family will need to provide consent before donation can go ahead so remember to discuss your decision with family and close friends.
contact: For feedback and other enquiries about organ and tissue donation, contact DonateLife.

faqs.q: Who can register as an organ donor?
faqs.a: You must be aged 16 or over to register your decision to donate your organs and tissues for transplant after death.

faqs.q: Do I need to talk to my family?
faqs.a: Yes, your family will need to provide consent before donation can go ahead, so you should discuss your decision with family and close friends.

faqs.q: How can I check if I am already registered?
faqs.a: You can check if you are already registered as a donor.
